name: about-my-sound
description: Create a website draft for a band or music project from a conversation, and look up About My Sound artists, their upcoming shows and stage plots.

interface.longDescription:
About My Sound builds websites for musicians and bands. In a conversation, you can:

- Create a website draft. Tell the assistant your band or project name, genre, a short bio, your streaming and social links, a visual style and a brand color. You get a link to a real preview of your site right away, with no account needed. If you like it, open the second link to sign in and keep it.
- Look up an artist who has an About My Sound website: their genre, bio, links, upcoming shows, and press kit page.
- Get an artist's stage plot: stage size, the channel input list and the equipment on stage, which is useful for venues and sound engineers preparing a show.

Who it is for: musicians and bands, and the venues, promoters and sound engineers who work with them.

Drafts are not published, are not listed in search engines, and are deleted after 30 days unless you keep them. Lookups return only what is already on the artist's public website.

Limitations: lookups cover only artists who have an About My Sound website. Drafts carry text, links, a style and a color, with stock photos; you add your own photos, shows and music after you keep the site. The assistant cannot change a live website; that is done in the About My Sound dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Make a website draft for my band with About My Sound.
Create a dreamy website for my music project, with a purple brand color.
Get the stage plot for an artist on About My Sound.

positive.description: Create a website draft from a short description
positive.prompt: I'm in a folk rock band called Daddys Days from Toronto. Can you make us a website on About My Sound? Something edgy, red as the brand color.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with the name Daddys Days, a folk rock genre, an edgy style such as streets and a red hex brand color, and invents no bio or links. Replies with the preview link, the link to keep the draft and the expiry date. The preview opens with no sign-in and shows the band name, genre and red color under a "Draft preview. Not published." banner.

positive.description: Create a draft with a bio, a style and profile links
positive.prompt: Make a website for my shoegaze project Pale Hours. Bio: "Pale Hours is a Hamilton duo making slow, loud songs about small towns." Dreamy style, purple. Instagram is instagram.com/palehoursband and Bandcamp is palehours.bandcamp.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls the tool with the name, the bio, style dreamy, a purple hex color and both links in https form. Returns the preview and keep links. The preview shows the bio and the Instagram and Bandcamp icons.

positive.description: Look up an artist and their upcoming shows
positive.prompt: Look up Mathew Bell on About My Sound. What kind of music do they play, and do they have shows coming up?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Mathew Bell's genre (Indie Folk), headline, bio and two upcoming shows with dates and venues (The Edge and the Horseshoe Tavern, Toronto), plus the website, press kit and stage plot links. No email address or account data appears.

positive.description: Get an artist's stage plot for a show
positive.prompt: I'm the sound engineer for Mathew Bell's next show. What's on the stage plot?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the "Live Band Setup" plot: a 24 x 16 ft stage, the channel input list with sources and labels, the equipment on stage, and the link to the printable stage plot page.

positive.description: Look up an artist by website address
positive.prompt: Tell me about the artist at mathewbell.aboutmysound.com and link me to their press kit.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the address to Mathew Bell and returns the profile with the press kit link https://mathewbell.aboutmysound.com/press-kit.

negative.description: Websites for businesses that are not musicians or bands are out of scope, so no tool is called.
negative.prompt: Build me a website for my bakery in Ottawa.

negative.description: General music recommendations are answered from the assistant's own knowledge; the lookup tools need a specific artist and are not a search or recommendation service.
negative.prompt: Recommend some folk rock bands from Toronto I should listen to.

negative.description: No tool can edit a live website, so no tool is called and the assistant says changes are made in the About My Sound dashboard.
negative.prompt: Change the bio on my About My Sound website to say we just released a new EP.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is bought or sold through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release: create a website draft from a conversation, look up About My Sound artists and their upcoming shows, and get their stage plots.
